entities.name: Query protein (93 aa Ppnp)
observations: The 93-residue sequence matches the bacterial Ppnp domain (Pfam PF06865) at positions 3–92 with i-Evalue 1.3e-35.
It shares 68.5% identity with reviewed Swiss-Prot pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases over 98.9% query coverage.
Likely cytosolic nucleoside phosphorylase; exact substrate range is inferred from homologs rather than experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Q0VL74
observations: Reviewed Alcanivorax borkumensis pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase annotated with EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.
Catalyzes phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to D-ribose 1-phosphate and the corresponding free base; reverse reactions are also catalyzed.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: purine or pyrimidine D-ribonucleoside + phosphate ⇌ corresponding nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Reference Rhea reactions include guanosine, adenosine, cytidine, inosine, and other nucleoside phosphorolysis reactions.
